title: Microsoft 365 Outage Response
description: Microsoft 365 service outages affecting legal operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on legal operations and client communications
Implement alternative communication methods if needed
Activate service desk for user support
investigation_steps: Check Microsoft 365 service status from vendor portal
Review Microsoft 365 admin center for issues
Verify network connectivity to Microsoft services
resolution_steps: Contact Microsoft support for service issues
Coordinate with Microsoft for service restoration
verification: Confirm with legal staff that services are operational
special_considerations: Security incidents involving privileged legal documents require immediate escalation
Maintain client confidentiality during service restoration
Document any service interruptions that may affect client deadlines
